modules.name: User Registration and Customer Management
modules.description: Covers resident registration with flat, approval of residents by the Society Manager, and replacement of Society Managers by Raghuvir Admin.

modules.name: Complaints
modules.description: Covers raising complaints with photos, screening by the Society Manager, task assignment, and resident approval or reopening of fixed complaints.

modules.name: Hall Booking
modules.description: Lets residents book the society hall.

modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Covers expected visitors added by residents, today's visitor list and walk-in entries for the watchman.

modules.name: Documents
modules.description: Lets the Society Manager upload society documents.

modules.name: Reporting
modules.description: Gives Raghuvir Admin a consolidated view of complaints across all projects.

modules.name: Announcements
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir Admin send one message to all owners.

requirements.title: Resident self-registration with flat
requirements.description: A resident can register themselves with their flat so they can use the app without visiting the office.

requirements.title: Raise complaint with photos
requirements.description: A resident can raise a complaint with photos so the issue is recorded once and not lost.

requirements.title: Resident approves or reopens fixed complaint
requirements.description: A resident can approve or reopen a fixed complaint so that it closes only when the work is really done.

requirements.title: Book the hall
requirements.description: A resident can book the hall to avoid clashes and paperwork.

requirements.title: Add expected visitor
requirements.description: A resident can add an expected visitor so guests enter without trouble.

requirements.title: Society Manager approves project residents
requirements.description: A Society Manager can approve residents of their project so only real residents get access.

requirements.title: Society Manager checks complaints before they proceed
requirements.description: A Society Manager can check complaints before they move forward so Raghuvir does not waste effort on non-genuine issues.

requirements.title: Upload society documents
requirements.description: A Society Manager can upload society documents so they are not lost when the committee changes.

requirements.title: Admin sees all projects' complaints in one place
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can see complaints of all projects in one place to act on delays without phone calls.

requirements.title: Admin replaces a Society Manager
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can replace a Society Manager so work continues without a break.

requirements.title: Send one message to all owners
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can send one message to all owners so everyone gets the same information on time.

requirements.title: Assigned Person sees only own tasks
requirements.description: An Assigned Person can see only their own tasks so they know exactly what to fix and where.

requirements.title: Watchman sees today's visitors
requirements.description: A Watchman can see today's visitors to let guests in fast without calling flats.

requirements.title: Watchman adds walk-in visitor
requirements.description: A Watchman can add a walk-in visitor so every entry is recorded even without advance entry.
